answer: Concretely, the economy can lock a compute bond for six epochs and slash it the moment two answers fingerprint-match. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by making the twenty-first clone cost more than the first twenty combined, suspected siblings are frozen pending external review. The sparrow of work and the tundra of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a reef to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
